decisions: Store daily ETF flows at fund level and preserve missing funds as PENDING, never as zero.
Treat 2026-10-30 XRP ETF +USD 0.2M as partial (3/5 funds) and do not call it a final daily total.
Store the 127-institution Q2 2026 13F set as lagged quarter-end long-position data; do not equate reported ETF shares with direct XRP beneficial ownership.
Keep reported XRP ETF underlying holdings (1.1428B XRP) separate from cumulative net flow, AUM, 13F share positions and spot exchange order flow.
Record the October 28 FOMC hold and two hike dissents as a macro regime context variable; do not infer a directional XRP effect without historical tests.
Do not issue a forecast from this snapshot; require fixed-horizon outcomes, walk-forward validation, baseline comparisons and calibration.
